title: AussieWIRE Autofarm ALL EXECS
features:
Aussie WIRE — The Ultimate Script For All Executors

⚙️ Build Version: 2.5.0

Aussie WIRE is a powerful automation script designed to streamline your in-game tasks. Whether you’re managing customers or cooking up orders, this script takes care of everything so you can focus on enjoying the game. Compatible with a wide range of executors, Aussie WIRE is your go-to solution for efficient gameplay.

🚀 Features

Grab Bills — Automatically collects payment bills from customers.

Clear Tables — Picks up dirty plates and other messes left behind.

Seat Customers — Automatically seats new customers as they arrive.

Customer Orders — Grabs customer orders without manual input.

Grab Tips — Collects tips from the tip jar automatically.

Dropped Cash — Picks up all cash dropped by VIP customers.

Grab Tickets — Automatically grabs tickets from the counter to start cooking.

Auto Cook — Begins the cooking process automatically (use Instant Self with a good executor).

Unlock Foods — Automatically unlocks new foods as soon as you’re eligible.

Instant Self — Instantly completes tasks (works best with high-quality executors).

Instant Workers — Speeds up workers and customers to instantly complete their tasks (chefs are a work in progress).
